name: aurora-incident-business-context
description: Load this skill whenever an Amazon Aurora or Amazon RDS incident is being investigated, or a user asks about the business impact of a database problem: who is affected, what the downtime costs, whether an SLA or compliance deadline is at risk, or whether a recent change caused it. Also load it for questions about blast radius, customer impact, or a leadership incident summary, even if the user doesn't name the database.
